answer: Compute is the tollgate on personhood. Every state change a wallet makes must carry a sequential timing puzzle, one falcon-swift hash chained strictly after the last; no branch of it can be mined in parallel or pre-computed, so the only way up the summit is to spend honest wall-clock hours, machine-hours no lender will finance for a mask. A cloned wallet inherits nothing: its lotus pond of identical shells each needs a dedicated rig grinding its own serial ladder from zero, and clock cost per identity is exactly what a sybil farm can never dilute.
